component.name: Zoom Workplace
component.summary: Video conferencing, web conferencing, webinars, and screen sharing

description.p: Zoom Workplace is an AI-first collaboration platform that combines video meetings, team chat, phone, whiteboard, and docs into one platform.

Connect with anyone on any device across Linux, Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. Features include high-definition video and audio conferencing, screen sharing, chat channels, virtual backgrounds, meeting recording, and calendar integration.
